actions.name: system.whoami
actions.description: Who the API takes the caller to be: the subject, client, scopes and workspace of the access token the request carries.
actions.label: system:actions.whoami

CallerKind.description: Who a token was issued to.

WhoamiOutput.description: The caller, as the access token describes it.

client_id.description: The client the token was issued to, when it names one.

kind.description: A person signed in through a client, or a client on its own behalf.

scopes.description: The scopes the token grants, sorted.

subject.description:
The token's subject (or, for a client acting on its own behalf, its
client id).

workspace.description: The workspace a client is bound to; none for people.
